name: Wiki Live Challenge
intro: Wiki Live Challenge是一个实时基准，旨在评估深度研究代理（DRA）生成专家级维基百科文章的能力。该基准利用最新的维基百科优良条目（Good Articles）作为专家级参考，并提出了包含39个写作质量标准和事实可验证性指标的Wiki Eval评估框架。实验表明，现有DRA与人类专家水平存在显著差距，验证了WLC在推动智能体研究方面的有效性。
org: University of Science and Technology of China
eval_feature: 动态, 实时, 防污染
intro_en: Wiki Live Challenge is a real-time benchmark designed to evaluate Deep Research Agents' (DRA) ability to generate expert-level Wikipedia articles. It uses the latest Wikipedia Good Articles as expert references and introduces the Wiki Eval evaluation framework, which includes 39 writing quality criteria and factual verifiability metrics. Experiments show a significant gap between current DRAs and human experts, validating WLC's effectiveness in advancing agent research.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Wiki Live Challenge arXiv:2602.01590v2 (2026-02-03), Sections 3.1-3.2 and Figures 2-3; official repository https://github.com/WangShao2000/Wiki_Live_Challenge, release v1.0 snapshot 2025_Mar_Nov. The reproducible paper window is 2025-03-01 through 2025-12-01 and reference pages were frozen 2025-12-15; the README's generic six-month rolling-window language is a refresh-policy note, not this historical build window.. Wiki Live Challenge filters newly created Wikipedia pages through expert-reviewed Good Article status, ranks the resulting 304 candidates by citation richness and structural depth, rejects list pages, and curates 100 articles across 15 domains. Evaluation keeps Wiki Writing and Wiki Fact separate: Gemini-2.5-Pro compares generated and original articles on 39 criteria, while Gemini-2.5-Flash measures reference-fact coverage from top-10 statement retrieval and a separate Jina-backed branch measures citation support.
